jobs.name: 01_三間槍足軽
jobs.prompt:
Use case: compositing / illustration-story.
Edit the attached small troop illustration into ONE finished standalone troop-art asset for a Sengoku tabletop wargame. Output a square 1000 x 1000 pixel PNG with a genuinely transparent background.
STYLE INVARIANTS: closely match the supplied flat 2D Japanese game illustration: confident black ink outlines, restrained cel shading, simplified faces, the same clothing/armor shapes and original foreground colors. Cleanly redraw at higher resolution, do not merely stretch the tiny bitmap. Do not turn it into photorealism, realistic digital painting, chibi art, or 3D.
COMPOSITION: one dominant foreground figure anchored at the lower left, with TWO smaller, less detailed same-unit soldiers receding diagonally into the middle/right. The rear formation should occupy the previously empty right half, but remain clearly secondary: muted desaturated green/gray/brown colors, much softer thinner outlines, and lower contrast, not ghostly semi-transparent duplicates. Vary rear poses naturally. The main recognizable silhouette should touch the lower and left crop boundaries naturally; no rectangular clipping through a subject in the middle of the image. Keep useful foreground helmet/armor/weapon details in the leftmost 20% and bottommost 20%, since a commander counter may cover the upper-right central 80% in play. The layout still must look balanced without that covering counter. Fill most of the square with the group, with transparent breathing room between silhouettes.
BACKGROUND / OUTPUT: true alpha outside figures; no white or colored rectangle, checkerboard, paper texture, scenery, ground, border, UI, lettering, numbers, icons, flags, watermark, or extra weapons from other troop types. The user's existing cloud/paper texture will be underneath this transparent art. This is an art-only asset, not a complete card.
UNIT: 三間槍足軽 — exceptionally long straight-shaft yari ashigaru, specifically the user's three-ken long-pike unit, NOT short-spear infantry or elite spear samurai. Keep the original foreground soldier's black conical jingasa with the plain gold oval, green sleeves, dark simple armor with gold details, and forward/diagonal pike-holding pose. Make the spear visibly very long compared with a human: a long uninterrupted slender wooden shaft with a small simple straight point, NO cross-shaped spearhead, halberd, naginata, or short thick staff. In the rear, two similarly equipped ashigaru carry long, near-parallel shafts rising diagonally across the upper and right half, giving a readable long-pike formation. It is fine for the far shaft end to exit the top edge, conveying its length; do not shorten it to fit. Preserve the primary soldier's visual identity and basic pose.
